scope: Proposition 7.1 (Edge comparison) of the manuscript “Critical mixing in the Sherrington–Kirkpatrick model” (preprints/Critical-mixing-in-the-Sherrington-Kirkpatrick-model-September-25-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 227 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 3ac6296cc238bae9), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 26. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: Assume the spectral event of Lemma 5.1. Suppose r ≤ n−1/3 logC1 n, λ − λ0 ≤ n−2/3 logC2 n, ∥h∥ ≤ √ n r log n, where C1, C2 are fixed. Set L = n2/3 and A0 = 2I − J. Outside Haar mass o(1), Z(h) Zo(h) = 1 + o(1). The cube and spherical raw second moments about mo differ in operator norm by at most n1/2+o(1). The cube raw second moment, sandwiched by A0, has operator norm at most n1/6+o(1). Each exponent bound can be read with any fixed positive exponent slack. Unspecified powers of logarithms may depend on C1, C2.
